summary: T3 Defense Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the cancellation of $2,138,962 in notes (principal and accrued interest) held by CEO Menachem Shalom in exchange for 4,174,399 restricted shares of common stock at $0.5124 per share, equal to the last consolidated bid price. The notes were assigned from Star 26 Capital Inc. under a prior securities purchase agreement and call option. The transaction is a debt-for-equity swap, not a special situation. There is no premium, tender offer, strategic review, or change of control. The issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506 of Regulation D. No other special-situation event is present.
